title: Basis Note: The Volume a Membership and Patronage Equity Capital Retain Is Taken On for a Fiscal Year
content:
Which volume the capital retain for a fiscal year is taken on turns on what the equity ledger carries for the year most recently allocated.

**Where the accrual lines have overtaken the notice.** Where an allocation notice stands posted for the year most recently allocated and the accrual lines recorded for the year on the grain basis carry more volume than it was posted on, the retain is taken on the sum of those accrual lines together with the crop input spend standing accrued for the year.

**Where no notice stands posted.** Where no allocation notice stands posted for the year most recently allocated and accrual lines stand for it on the grain basis, the retain is taken on the sum of those accrual lines alone, no crop input spend being carried.

**Otherwise.** The retain is taken on the volume the allocation notice for the year was posted on together with the crop input spend standing accrued for the year.

## The readings side by side, on hypothetical figures

| Volume the notice was posted on | Accrual lines for the year on the grain basis | Crop input spend standing accrued | Volume the retain is taken on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 18000.00 | 21400.00 | 9000.00 | 21400.00 together with 9000.00 |
| none posted | 21400.00 | 9000.00 | 21400.00 alone |
| 18000.00 | 16200.00 | 9000.00 | 18000.00 together with 9000.00 |
| 18000.00 | 18000.00 | 9000.00 | 18000.00 together with 9000.00 |

**On the second line.** Where no notice stands posted for the year most recently allocated, the crop input spend is not carried at all, and the grain accrual lines alone are the volume.

**On the fourth line.** Accrual lines coming to exactly the volume the notice was posted on carry no more than it, so the first reading does not hold and the last one does.

This is a matter of the member's own Membership and Patronage Equity record for the year most recently allocated, and of nothing else.
